create.name: Helen Hamilton
create.bio:
An English spiritual teacher, Helen Hamilton teaches in the non-dual tradition of Self-realisation. Her teaching arose from her own awakening, which she experienced as a long and difficult process, and she wants to make that path simpler and available to anyone. As she puts it, the truth of who we are is simple, and anyone can realise the Self. She was based in West Yorkshire for many years and is a mother of four.

Satsang is her main form: a talk followed by open questions, offered free on Zoom twice a month. Alongside these she holds weekend intensives and residential retreats in Britain, Spain and the United States, many of them recorded. Five practices underpin her method: meditation, contemplation, self-inquiry, conscious imagining and what she calls the Statement Process. Those who want to go deeper can join the Helen Hamilton Sangha, a monthly membership with live classes, a growing archive and support from acharya teachers she has trained. Balboa Press publishes her series of books, the first being Dissolving the Ego and Transcending the Mind, and several short ebooks are free on her website.

books.title: Dissolving The Ego
books.author: Helen Hamilton
books.description: An introduction to her teaching, which she suggests reading first. It sets out fourteen pathways for recognising the true Self beyond the mind and senses.

books.title: Transcending The Mind: Some Disassembly Required!: How to take apart your noisy mind
books.author: Helen Hamilton
books.description: A companion to Dissolving the Ego that lays out the stages of karmic patterns of thought and feeling, and a step-by-step way of contemplating and undoing them.

books.title: Reality Check: A Simple Guide to Final Enlightenment
books.author: Helen Hamilton
books.description: Written for readers who have glimpsed their real nature and want to move past the last dualities of real and unreal, Self and ego.

books.title: How to Fall in Love with Yourself
books.author: Helen Hamilton
books.description: An exploration of conditional and unconditional love, and of moving from judging ourselves and others towards acceptance of whatever is.

books.title: Hamilton Gita: Musings from the One
books.author: Helen Hamilton
books.description: A collection of short contemplative writings from the perspective of oneness, meant to be read at any stage of the path.

books.title: Empowerment Course Handbook
books.author: Helen Hamilton
books.description: Brings together three of her courses: on forgiveness; on desire, manifestation and abundance; and on transcending the vasanas, or habitual patterns, that arise as awakening unfolds.

courses.title: Helen Hamilton Sangha
courses.description: A monthly online membership with three live classes a month with Helen (a core teaching, self-inquiry and a question-and-answer session), an archive of recorded classes, members' events and a WhatsApp community. Members can also have one-to-one support from her trained acharya teachers; join or cancel at any time.

courses.title: Being the Loving Awareness: Weekend Intensive in Beavercreek, Ohio
courses.description: A weekend in Beavercreek, Ohio, opening with a free Friday satsang, followed by two days of talks, guided meditation, contemplation, self-inquiry and satsang. Booking closes 14 November 2026.

courses.title: Embodying Silence and Wisdom: Weekend Intensive in Leeds
courses.description: A weekend intensive in Leeds, West Yorkshire, with talks, guided meditation, contemplation, self-inquiry and satsang across two days, plus a Friday satsang for Sangha members.

courses.title: Awakening To Truth: Weekend Intensive in Madrid
courses.description: A weekend intensive in central Madrid with live Spanish translation, following her usual pattern of talk, guided meditation, contemplation, self-inquiry and satsang.

courses.title: Living As The Loving Presence Retreat (recordings)
courses.description: Video recordings of a five-day online retreat held in April 2026, with a talk, guided meditation, satsang and guided contemplation or self-inquiry for each day.

courses.title: Beyond Seeking, Into Freedom Retreat (recordings)
courses.description: Video recordings of an online retreat from November 2025: talks, guided meditations, satsangs and guided self-inquiries on freedom, acceptance and fear.

courses.title: Living From The Heart - Embodying Wisdom Intensive (recordings)
courses.description: Video recordings of a two-day online intensive from September 2026, including guided meditation, contemplation, self-inquiry, conscious imagining and the Statement Process.

free_resources.title: Free Ebooks by Helen Hamilton
free_resources.description: Five short ebooks free to download as PDFs, including Seeing with the Sages' Eyes, The Progression of Awakening and How to Always Hear the Silence.

free_resources.title: Free Satsangs with Helen Hamilton
free_resources.description: Live satsangs on Zoom twice a month, open to everyone: a talk of about thirty minutes followed by open questions. Selected questions are answered in a monthly recorded satsang on YouTube.

free_resources.title: Free Downloads: Guided Meditations and Readings
free_resources.description: Free audio of guided meditations and satsangs from her Madrid gatherings, and her readings from The Hamilton Gita.

flags: The email info@helenhamilton.com was decoded from a Cloudflare-protected link on her Sangha and event pages (note the .com domain, while the site is helenhamilton.org); the site says Helen cannot reply personally to emails.
Her location may have changed: older bios say West Yorkshire, but from December 2026 she holds monthly in-person satsangs in Asheville, North Carolina; the bio avoids stating where she now lives.

Four further Balboa Press books (Now That You Are Formless, The Story of I, Top Ten Myths about Enlightenment, Into the Heart of Being, plus ISBNs 198228319X, 1982283734, 1982283750, 1982289880) could not be checked: amazon.com /dp/ pages returned errors.
The Ohio weekend is priced in pounds on her site (£120 GBP), as published.
Her Statement Process is described on her site as 'using the physical body as a diagnostic tool'; that wording is kept out of the listing.
left_out: Older retreat and satsang intensive recordings (2019–2025) on her shop: older and many; the three most recent are included.
Residing As Presence (Watsonville, March 2027) and I Am Presence (Boone, October 2027): announced, but no pages or prices yet.
Abiding Liberation online retreat recordings: payment link only, no page of its own.
Books not verified on amazon.com (see flags).
